The plate is a square-ish dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across (about 355 px wide in the image). The corn piece is about 105 px across, which is roughly 7.5 cm. It looks like a cob segment seen end-on, about 3 to 4 cm long. A cylinder of that size has a volume of about 3.14 × 3.75² × 3.5 ≈ 155 cm³. The cob core takes up part of that, and I assume a density of about 0.6 for the kernels and cob together. That gives about 90 g. A cob segment of this size with the kernels still on would weigh roughly 80 to 100 g. A few loose kernels are also on the plate, adding about 2 g.
